note: Absolute targets for den, derived from den's own best measured numbers (docs/perf/baseline.md), not from Dia/Arc. Checked by scripts/perf.sh. All numbers were measured on 2026-09-27 on a Mac15,12 (M3, 8 cores, 16 GB, macOS 26.5, AC power) while other agents' builds kept the 1-min load average at 4.7 to 840; they are provisional until re-measured on a quiet machine. Budgets marked 'aspirational' fail today on purpose.

source.launchMedianMs: den warm launch (seeded store) median 209.3 ms, p90 238.1 ms, min 185.2 ms: 6 least-loaded rounds (load 4.7-7.9) of the interleaved run. Budget sits just above.
source.noTabsHostMB: den with zero tabs: host footprint median 20.0 MB, max 21.5 MB (n=5). No WebKit process exists in this state, so total == host.
source.idleCpuPct: target 0% with no active media; 0.1% is the measurement floor. Measured median 0.2%, max 0.3% (n=4, under load 200-580) - fails today (aspirational). top reported 0.0% CPU for the same process.
source.idleWakeupsPerSec: measured median 0.1/s, max 0.4/s (kernel pkg-idle + interrupt wakeups via proc_pid_rusage; top IDLEW showed 0 over 30 s).
source.perDiscardedTabKB: target ~0 (metadata only). M3 (2026-09-27): 80 KB per tab - fails (aspirational). CI runner perf lab after virtualized sidebar rows and on-demand tab menus (2026-09-28): 17.5 KB ((21.7 - 18.2 MB) / 200, n=5 medians; was 85 KB); scripts/perf.sh in CI: 15.9 KB. Still fails.
source.onePageTotalMB: den (empty store) + https://example.com opened at launch: total median 79.8 MB, max 81.1 MB (n=3), host 28.3 MB.

reference.note: Same method, same machine, same session; reference only. Dia stopped at its sign-in screen, so its numbers are for that screen, not a browsing window.

ciRunner.note: Measured on GitHub's macos-26 runner (Apple M1 (Virtual), 3 cores, 7 GB, macOS 26.6) by scripts/perf/lab.sh, n=5 medians of den's own process, 2026-09-28 (docs/perf/baseline.md 'Energy lane'). Reference for the report-only CI perf step; budgets above stay the M3 ones.
